name: Lake Meredith National Recreation Area
story: Lake Meredith National Recreation Area is located in Texas, USA, about 30 miles north of Amarillo in the Texas Panhandle. Its main attraction is 10,000-acre Lake Meredith, a reservoir created by Sanford Dam on the Canadian River.
matters: Alibates Flint Quarries National Monument is located adjacent to Lake Meredith National Recreation Area.
